pages.text: 40 health, 5 attack, 0.4 movement speed, 0.5 flying speed.$(br)Fire immune; on spawning it wears the Serpon Wizard set.$(br)$(l)Serpon Fireball$(): a mighty Serpon fireball that deals 10~52 fire damage and sets the target on fire for 15 seconds, exploding once with power 1.5 when it hits an entity.

$(l)Serpon Flames$(): rapid, continuous gouts of Serpon blaze with a 9-block reach, each dealing about 1 fire damage and setting the target on fire for 15 seconds, ignoring damage invulnerability frames. Named Fireball, it only throws fireballs.
